title: Cleopatra lived closer to the Moon landing than to the pyramids
caption: The Great Pyramid was already about 2,500 years old when Cleopatra was born. Apollo 11 was only about 2,000 years after her.
description: The Great Pyramid of Giza was completed around 2560 BC. Cleopatra VII was born in 69 BC, about 2,491 years later. From her birth to the Apollo 11 landing in 1969 is 2,037 years. Old Kingdom dates are uncertain by decades, which does not change the comparison.
sources: Great Pyramid of Giza, built for Khufu (reign c. 2589-2566 BC), completed c. 2560 BC
Cleopatra VII Philopator, born 69 BC, died 30 BC
